title: Publish CCP2 PHY coverage and qualification limits
description:
Scope: CCP-related rows in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/spec-coverage/02-physical-link.md and /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/spec-coverage/02-physical-link-flagged.md. Publish verified fixed-profile, full-frame airtime, channel-plan/index, actual receiver-resource and qualification limits using independent arithmetic, software-admission results and the RF qualification disposition. Separate nominal calculations from measured board behavior and authorization evidence. This is artifact interpretation/documentation only, with no radio operation or unrelated PHY coverage sweep.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Consume rf.12 and software evidence, not a broad parent completion label. Keep updates restricted to CCP requirements and preserve historical/unrelated coverage content.
acceptance_criteria: Every affirmative CCP-related PHY/configuration claim names matching source/profile/board evidence and its class. The 128-channel grid remains a candidate unless its exact tuple is qualified; tuning support, nominal band edges and compiled enums are not RF or grant proof. Passband, demodulator, retune and TX concurrency limitations match the actual disposition, including no-go/not-assessed results. Local links and claim-to-artifact checks pass without inventing blanket capacity or compliance claims.
